reasons: Both give two distinct one-sentence openings tied to what the colleagues themselves gain, and neither says anything about when to send or deliver a message. A keeps every concrete figure an explicit placeholder ("реальное число часов", "с такого-то числа"), while B's second opening asserts specifics the request never gave - three days and two support threads today, half a day and none after, within a month - and its closing note retracts only the durations, so B is weaker on the no-invention item even though its lines are the more quotable ones.
